npcs.name: Cliff-Warden Thonjolf
npcs.greet: The sea-cliffs groaned again last night, and the Jarl's guards have barred the College bridge until someone answers for the ward-tremors in Saarthal.

npcs.name: Proctor Mirabelle
npcs.greet: The townsfolk blame our apprentices for every cracked foundation, yet rogue necromancers in the ice-caves are siphoning the coastal anchors.

npcs.name: Foreman Gundar
npcs.greet: Frost-wraiths have been rising along the iron seams ever since the excavation seals at Saarthal were pried open.

winterhold_bridge_compact: Proctor Mirabelle: The restored Saarthal anchor-stones and the seized siphon-staves from Hob's Fall prove the College held the cliff-face together.
Cliff-Warden Thonjolf: And the Ysgramor runestone restores the old crown-oath between the longhouse and the hall of scholars.
Proctor Mirabelle: Then unbar the bridge—Winterhold and the College keep the northern watch together.

stages.objective: Hear the cliff-warden's complaint at the bridge gate in Winterhold.
Inspect the cracked resonance-pillars inside Whistling Mine.
Present the fractured pillar-core to the proctor at the College of Winterhold.
Review the coastal ward-readings in the Arcanaeum.
Defeat the necromancer cabal siphoning the cliff-anchors in Hob's Fall Cave.
Re-seat the stolen ward-key stone inside the deep vault of Saarthal.
Receive the twilight augury at the Shrine of Azura overlooking the glacier.
Recover the ancient treaty-tablet from the sea-crypt of Ysgramor's Tomb.
Witness the joint compact between Jarl and Proctor in Winterhold.
